_comment: Unattended full-auto profile. NOT auto-loaded by Claude Code — pass it explicitly for headless `--auto` runs. It removes permission prompts and therefore requires unattended-preflight.js before delegation. The external runtime must enforce the exact signed unattended-policy.json: deny-by-default egress, no host credentials, read-only hooks/settings/trust/authority, and brokered credential execution. Hooks are defense in depth, not an OS boundary. Do NOT make this the default settings.json.
